collisionSection.title: Two Forces Colliding — And the Path Forward for Saudi Enterprises
collisionSection.vision2030Text: Vision 2030 accelerates AI adoption across the Kingdom's transformation agenda.
collisionSection.pdplText: PDPL enforcement is now fully active, demanding unbreakable data sovereignty and accountability.

aiRisk.title: Uncontrolled AI Creates Invisible Exposure at Enterprise Scale
aiRisk.point1: Employees and teams increasingly adopt public AI tools for speed, often bypassing formal procurement and governance controls.
aiRisk.point2: When sensitive data leaves sovereign control, accountability, audit trails, and national data residency are compromised — risking regulatory scrutiny in an active PDPL environment.
aiRisk.point3: For PIF-linked entities, listed companies, and regulated institutions, this exposure threatens strategic projects and Vision 2030 commitments.

advisoryGap.title: Elite Advisory Remains Inaccessible at Required Velocity
advisoryGap.point1: Traditional Big Four cycles — rigorous but slow and resource-intensive — struggle to match the pace of AI-driven transformation.
advisoryGap.point2: Compliance obligations (PDPL, CMA, SAMA, NCA) apply universally across organizations, yet procurement timelines and costs limit timely support.
advisoryGap.point3: Enterprises need governed, audit-ready GRC solutions now — not after prolonged engagements.

collisionSection.closing: We understand the pressures you face: delivering on Vision 2030's ambitious timeline while safeguarding data sovereignty in a regulated landscape. At Aliph Solutions, we bridge this collision with sovereign AI-enabled advisory — combining 30+ years of proven Big Four expertise with governed, Kingdom-first architecture. Our 15-agent workflows and compounding Aliph Brain deliver precise, audit-ready outcomes — faster, more securely, and fully aligned with Saudi priorities.
